answers.core: There's no reason to show 4.x projects in 3.x's project manager. While the other way there's some merit, upgrading projects isn't something you do every day (and always include extra steps, such as making backups and cleaning up problems afterwards).
answers.workaround: One workaround would be making portable installations of different versions, each having their own project list.

title: Hide incompatible projects in project manager
